description: NaNbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.97 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-26°. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
